page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words inline; running head at top; no marginal notes of text.

main_text.p: gyptios vocatus fuit Sarapis,ut videre eft apud Macrob.lib.1.20.quòd nempe omnia comburat.

שְׂרָף Chald. Seraph, nomen Angelorum: Item Serpens,Prefter ignitus, Numer. 21.7.in Targ. Hierof. Item certa quædam aromatum fpecies, Genef.37. 25.& 43.10. Jonath. Plural. שְׂרָפִים Seraphim, Genef. 30.22.in Targum Hierofol. emphat. & cum סְרָפִיא, Ezech. 1.8.
שְׁרַק Ch. Sibilavit, exfibilavit, fibilando advocavit.Hebr. שָׁרַק.
מְשְׁרוֹקִיתָא Chal. Fiftula, à fono fibilo fic dicta, Dan.3. Græc. σύριγξ Fistula, συρικτὴς Fistulator.
שִׁרְקְרָקָא Ch. Merops,avis immundę nomen,Deut.14.17.& Levit.11.18.in Jon.Onkel.habet יִרְקְרִיקָא.
שרך Syr. Confirmari, ftabiliri, Hinc Confirmati funt pedes ejus, Act.3.7.
Ethpahel Confirmari, Corroborari. Aphel Confirmavit, Act.3.16. Et confirmatus fuit, firmiter credidit, ad Roman.4.21. Fœminin. Quòd firmiter crederet, fibi perfuaderet, Ad Hebr.11.11.
Syr. Verax, verus: Ch. לֵאשְׁרִיר Non erit firmus,Prov.19.7. Reg. לֵאשְׁרִיר Non erit refiduum. Plural. Fœmin. Vera: verum, veritas.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldaic words are only approximately reproduced; the Syriac script and vowel pointing in several entries are doubtful and were not reliably read. Greek words in the fourth entry are approximate.
